title: ClaimDB: A Fact Verification Benchmark over Large Structured Data
authors_zh: Michael Theologitis, Preetam Prabhu Srikar Dammu, Chirag Shah, Dan Suciu
paper_type_zh: 大规模结构化数据上的可执行事实核验基准
best_for_zh: 需要评估数据库推理、事实核验或证据不足判断的研究者。
one_line: ClaimDB turns large-database fact verification into executable reasoning with three-way evidence labels.
ClaimDB 以真实多表数据库和三类证据标签，测试模型能否用可执行程序完成大规模事实核验。
why: It exposes failures that text-only factuality benchmarks cannot reveal.
inclusion_reason: ClaimDB evaluates fact verification where evidence must be computed from large relational data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Traditional fact-verification benchmarks provide short textual evidence that a model can read directly. Real data-analysis claims may depend on aggregation, joins, and comparisons across multiple tables and millions of rows, where long-context reading is infeasible. Models must also abstain when evidence is insufficient rather than force support or refutation.

ClaimDB defines verification as executable reasoning over real databases: a system generates queries or analysis programs for a claim and maps execution results to entailment, contradiction, or insufficient evidence.

传统事实核验 benchmark 的证据通常是一段文本，模型可以直接阅读；真实数据分析中的 claim 却可能依赖多个表和数百万行记录的聚合、连接与比较。长上下文阅读在这种规模下不可行，且模型还必须判断“证据不足”，而不是强迫给出支持或反驳。

ClaimDB 把事实核验定义为对真实数据库执行程序：系统根据 claim 生成查询或分析代码，再将执行结果映射为蕴含、矛盾或证据不足。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: ClaimDB covers 80 real-world databases spanning governance, healthcare, media, education, and natural sciences and releases 51,369 claim–database–evidence or label records. Each claim requires compositional operations over large structured data and receives an entailment, contradiction, or insufficient-evidence label together with schemas, execution resources, and a leaderboard. It moves factuality judging from reading evidence text to generating executable verification programs with abstention, supporting structured grounding and data-agent evaluation.

ClaimDB 覆盖 80 个真实数据库，领域包括治理、医疗、媒体、教育和自然科学；公开列表含 51,369 条 claim—数据库—证据/标签记录。每个 claim 需要对大型结构化数据进行组合运算，标签为 entailment、contradiction 或 insufficient evidence，并配套数据库 schema、执行资源和 leaderboard。它推动 factuality Judge 从“读证据文本”转为“生成可执行验证程序并允许 abstention”，适合结构化 grounding 与数据 Agent 评价。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select real databases: Eighty public databases are standardised by schema, table relationships, and executable environment across domains and scales.
  1. Generate and filter claims: Claims requiring aggregation, comparison, joins, or temporal reasoning are created from database content, while trivial lookups are removed.
  1. Execute deterministic labels: Reference queries or programs produce evidence that is mapped to entailment, contradiction, or insufficient evidence, with checks that query semantics match the natural-language claim.
  1. Build evaluation: Models generate executable programs or direct labels, which are run in a common sandbox and scored for three-way accuracy and abstention. Reproduction requires fixed database snapshots and SQL engines.

1. 选择真实数据库： 整理 80 个公开数据库，标准化 schema、表关系和可执行环境，并覆盖多领域与不同规模。
  1. 生成与筛选 claims： 依据数据库内容构造需要聚合、比较、连接或时间推理的 claim，并去除直接查表即可回答的简单样本。
  1. 执行确定标签： 运行参考查询或程序获得数据证据，映射为蕴含、矛盾或证据不足，并检查查询与自然语言语义一致。
  1. 构建评测： 模型需生成可执行程序或直接判定，统一沙箱运行并计算三分类准确率与 abstention。复现需固定数据库快照和 SQL 引擎。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The authors evaluate 30 proprietary and open models below 70B. More than half score below 55% accuracy, and none exceeds roughly 83%. Both closed and open models struggle with insufficient-evidence abstention, showing that good binary accuracy does not imply reliable data analysis. Multi-table, large-record settings break direct evidence-reading approaches and support executable verification, although tool access, sampling budgets, and error recovery affect fair comparison.
作者评测 30 个专有和 70B 以下开放模型；超过一半准确率低于 55%，没有模型超过约 83%。闭源和开放模型都在 insufficient-evidence abstention 上明显困难，说明较高二分类正确率不能代表可靠数据分析。多表和大规模记录使直接阅读证据方法失效，支持程序化验证的必要性；但不同系统是否使用工具、采样预算和错误恢复会影响公平比较。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier fact-verification data use web passages, knowledge-graph triples, or small tables as evidence. ClaimDB makes truth depend on compositional queries over large real databases and treats undecidability from available evidence as a first-class label. The central changes are evidence scale, executable contracts, and abstention rather than simply more textual claims.
既有 fact verification 数据以网页段落、知识图谱三元组或小表格为证据。ClaimDB 的新意是让 claim 的真值依赖真实大型数据库中的组合查询，并把“无证据可决定”作为一等标签。改变的核心是 evidence scale、程序执行契约和 abstention，而不是增加更多文本 claim。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Database snapshots: Updates can change claim truth. Reproduction must preserve database versions and reference queries, not only natural-language labels.
  1. Program equivalence: Different correct queries may yield the same evidence, so string matching is invalid. Execution results and resource limits should determine correctness.
  1. Real-world complexity: Public databases are relatively clean, while enterprise data include permissions, missingness, latency, and schema evolution, so scores may overestimate deployment readiness.

1. 数据库快照： 数据更新会改变 claim 真值；任何复现必须保存数据库版本和参考查询，不能只存自然语言标签。
  1. 程序等价性： 不同正确查询可能返回同一证据，字符串匹配无法评价；应以执行结果和资源限制为准。
  1. 现实复杂度： 公开数据库较干净，真实企业数据还含权限、缺失、延迟和 schema 演化，benchmark 分数可能高估部署能力。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Structured-fact judging: Evaluate whether models generate SQL or programs to verify claims and report entailment, contradiction, and abstention separately.
  1. Data-agent training: Use reference programs and execution results as verifier rewards while preventing exploitation of database errors or timeout patterns.
  1. Grounding audits: Map structured claims in reports to database verification and preserve queries and results as auditable evidence.

1. 结构化事实 Judge： 评测模型生成 SQL/程序并执行核验 claim 的能力，单独报告 entailment、contradiction 和 abstention。
  1. 数据 Agent 训练： 使用参考程序和执行结果构造 verifier reward，但应防止模型利用数据库错误或超时模式投机。
  1. grounding 审计： 把长报告中的可结构化 claim 映射到数据库验证，并保留查询和结果作为可审计证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: ClaimDB extends fact verification to 80 large real databases and requires executable programs with abstention.
  1. Method takeaway: Real schemas, compositional claims, reference-query execution, and three-way labels are central.
  1. Data takeaway: The release contains 51,369 records across governance, health, education, media, and science.
  1. Evidence anchor: Among 30 models, more than half score below 55%, none exceeds about 83%, and insufficient-evidence handling is broadly weak.
  1. Reuse decision: Best for structured grounding and data agents; freeze databases and evaluate execution semantics.

1. 一句话定位： ClaimDB 将事实核验扩展到 80 个真实大型数据库，并要求可执行程序与 abstention。
  1. 方法抓手： 真实 schema、组合 claim、参考查询执行和三分类标签是核心。
  1. 数据抓手： 51,369 条记录，覆盖治理、医疗、教育、媒体和科学等领域。
  1. 证据锚点： 30 个模型中半数低于 55%，无模型超过约 83%，证据不足判断普遍薄弱。
  1. 复用决定： 适合结构化 grounding 和数据 Agent；必须冻结数据库并使用执行语义评价。
